ai_agent.definition: An AI system that plans and acts toward a goal, using tools and intermediate steps rather than answering in one shot.

input_tokens.definition: The tokens you send, counted and billed on the way in. Documents and chat history both count here.
input_tokens.example: Uploading the same file twice charges the input tokens twice.

instant_gratification.definition: The preference for rewards that arrive immediately over larger rewards that require waiting and effort.

intel_cognitive_profile.definition: The pattern of strengths and weaknesses a person shows across different kinds of thinking.
intel_cognitive_profile.example: Her cognitive profile is strong with people and weak with long tables of numbers.

intelill_reliability.definition: The quality of a measurement that gives a similar result when it is repeated.
intelill_reliability.example: Two markers gave the same result, so the marking was reliable.

my_name_is.definition: The words you use to tell somebody your own name.
my_name_is.example: My name is Lan, and I am seven.

pump_ip_rating.definition: The IP code on the nameplate that says how well the casing keeps out solid objects and water.
pump_ip_rating.example: The nameplate of this pump carries an ingress protection rating of IP68.

rectangle.definition: A shape with four sides and four corners. It is longer than it is wide. A book is a rectangle.

reef.definition: A whole underwater city of coral. Thousands of kinds of fish live there.
reef.example: The reef was busy with small bright fish.
